fulfillment_judgment.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not identify any Phase III randomized controlled trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov or WHO ICTRP. fulfillment_judgment.useful_material: This study reports the MITRIC trial (NCT05286294), a single-arm phase IIa basket trial of FMT combined with ICIs in solid tumour patients (melanoma, HNSCC, RCC, pancreatic cancer).
